status: Preselected illustrative known instrument event; NOT independent accuracy test

target.reason: Official MAST instructional notebook documents a sudden sensitivity dropout near BKJD 547 in Kepler Q6 SAP photometry of KIC 7461601

method: Compare original SAP_FLUX versus PDC-corrected PDCSAP_FLUX on the same flagged Q6 event; apply localized step heuristic unchanged, including flagged rows for diagnostic plot only. Separate from science experiments which quality-mask rows.
expected_claims: Only an illustrative case study showing documented flux correction and whether the same fixed heuristic detects the flagged native change. The known quality flag is used ONLY as after-the-fact reference and display; not to decide where the detector searches.
visualization: two panels raw SAP vs PDCSAP normalized brightness around reported flag, with marked quality flag time. Preserve exact FITS fingerprint.
limits: One documented example, selected because it already has a known defect. Cannot estimate sensitivity, specificity, planet recovery or comparison to full ARC2/Robnik pipelines.
